description: Validates the pre-commit hook structure: must start with a shebang (#!/), must invoke scan.ps1 via pwsh or powershell, and must forward the exit code with 'exit $?'.

command.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$f = '${file}'; if ($f -notmatch '[/\\]pre-commit$') { exit 0 }; if ($f -notmatch '[/\\]\.github[/\\]codeql[/\\]hooks[/\\]pre-commit$') { exit 0 }; $c = Get-Content $f -Raw -ErrorAction Stop; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($c)) { Write-Host '[FAIL] pre-commit hook is empty:' $f; exit 2 }; $lines = Get-Content $f; if ($lines[0] -notmatch '^#!') { Write-Host '[FAIL] pre-commit hook missing shebang (#!/) on first line in' $f; exit 2 }; if ($c -notmatch 'scan\.ps1') { Write-Host '[FAIL] pre-commit hook does not invoke scan.ps1 in' $f; exit 2 }; if ($c -notmatch '(pwsh|powershell)') { Write-Host '[FAIL] pre-commit hook does not use pwsh or powershell to invoke scan.ps1 in' $f; exit 2 }; if ($c -notmatch 'exit\s+\$\?') { Write-Host '[FAIL] pre-commit hook missing exit \$? (exit code forwarding) in' $f; exit 2 }; exit 0"
